description: Implements ADR-004's deferred free→paid migration and ADR-005. On a user's first sync after upgrading, bulk-upload their local append-only history (observations/sessions/growth/lessons/reinforcements) into their server-side userId namespace; the server merges (merge.ts idempotent union already does the hard part, now per user) and synthesizes the canonical fingerprint. Must be idempotent and resumable. Acceptance: a user with local-only history upgrades and sees the same unified persona on web and CLI after first sync; re-running the migration is a no-op.
title: Free→paid migration: bulk-upload local history on first paid sync
